name: Kaiman Katan
source:
An upbeat, high-tension, and proactively romantic kouhai girl.
Her favorite things are romance reality TV shows. Her least favorite things are pill bugs.
She is highly social and cooperative—a total monster when it comes to communication skills.

Though she has never actually been in love before, a boy ([url=/c161706]Houzuki Enju[/url]) who perfectly matches her ideal image of "If I were to date someone, I'd want a guy like this~" just happened to move in next door.

She is deeply interested in Enju and is eager to become close with him.
However, she doesn't know yet what kind of secrets are hidden beneath his surface.


[u]B.E.G.[/u]
[b]Red Blade (赤刀) [i]<Trauma Core>[/i][/b]

A chainsaw that tears targets into pieces and restores them back to their original state.
The objects chopped to pieces suffer no actual harm, and their fundamental properties are preserved.
She can even sever her own arm and control it remotely.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html#Character]official website[/url]]
